title: YOLO | Designer WaterColor Home | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: YOLO is a pet-friendly WaterColor home with a private pool, bikes, golf cart, screened porches, and full access to the Beach Club and Camp WaterColor.
description_expanded: YOLO Features - Private pool with sundeck, lounge chairs, and Solar pool umbrellas - pool can be heated for an additional fee October through April - Access to 5 bikes, serviced regularly to ensure they are top shape for your arrival - Complimentary access to a 6-Seater LSV (Golf Cart)- some restrictions apply and must sign waiver to use cart during your stay - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, non-aggressive breeds only. Pets not allowed in the private pool. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. Unauthorized pets will result in fines and possible eviction. - 2-Minute bike ride to Camp WaterColor, with lazy river, multiple pools, water slides, cantina, and towel services (subject to availability by the HOA) - 1-Minute bike ride to Sand Hill park and pool (aka the Frog Pool) - Screened-in back porch with outdoor dining plus lounge with fireplace and TV - Conversation seating in landscaped backyard next to outdoor grill - Outdoor shower - Cable and WIFI - Professional kitchen with high-end appliances from Wolf - Dining area with seating for 8 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 - Laundry room with washer and dryer - Air and Surface Pro air purifier in living room and King Suite 2 - Front porch with seating and bench swing - Screened-in 2nd floor balcony with daybed swing - 2nd Floor open air balcony with cushioned seating set - Driveway parking for 3 cars - Concierge services available including beach service, grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, boat charters, and more - Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and WaterColor pools included with your stay for 12 guests, age 5 and up. - Community pools heated during cooler months (subject to change by the neighborhood) - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to YOLO! Only two minutes from Camp WaterColor, this luxurious Lake District home is where designer style and vacation comfort merge for the ultimate in WaterColor splendor. Designer interiors and very spacious floor plan create a relaxing and inspiring experience. Easily get to anywhere in WaterColor either by bike or LSV (golf cart). ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
